apps.localizedDescription:
This is the one and only official Air repository: herbrine8403/Amethyst-iOS-MyRemastered. Beware of unofficial forks or mirror repositories using the "Air" name — always verify that the repository owner is @herbrine8403 and that the URL matches the link above.

A premium Minecraft: Java Edition launcher for iOS and iPadOS, rebuilt from the ground up on the official Amethyst project. It delivers a refined mobile experience with comprehensive mod management, intelligent renderer selection, and deep platform integration.

Core Features:

• Modern UI Redesign -- The interface has been deeply refined for a contemporary, polished visual style.

• Modpack Import -- Import ZIP-format modpacks directly from the launcher interface.

• Complete Chinese Localization -- Fully translated interface with native-quality Chinese language support.

• Multi-Account -- Seamlessly switch between Microsoft, local, and third-party authentication accounts.

versions.localizedDescription:
Air 5.1.0:

• 支持 Metal(metallum)渲染器,可用于 Minecraft 26.2 / 26.3 @yiyeshi0-hash.

完整更新日志: https://github.com/herbrine8403/Amethyst-iOS-MyRemastered/compare/5.0.0.5.1.0

Air 5.1.0:

This update is mainly about Minecraft 26.3 support and fixes several issues including JIT startup crashes; it also adds an AI assistant and an automatic update check on launch. Both 26.2 and 26.3 work fine.

• Added Minecraft 26.3 support (SDL3 window / input / presentation): fixed the black screen on entering a world, the picture stuck in a corner, having to change the resolution once to get a picture, wrong display in small windows, frame rate always showing 0 with Vulkan, resolution switching not working, the on-screen keyboard and control buttons not typing, the inventory not being clickable, and wrong hotbar keys @yitenchen123 @Gsjsjzhznsz @herbrine8403.
• Fixed why the MobileGlues renderer crashed on 26.3: a render hook mistook itself for the real implementation and kept calling itself until it crashed @yiyeshi0-hash.
• Added Metal (metallum) renderer support for Minecraft 26.2 / 26.3 @yiyeshi0-hash.
• Added the MobileGL / MobileGL-gles renderers, and SimpleFPEWrapper (sfpew) to support 1.17 and below (enable sfpew in the settings and pick MobileGL-gles as the renderer); also fixed MobileGlues crashes and black screens on 26.3 @yitenchen123.
• Upgraded the built-in MobileGlues sources to upstream 2.0.x; the shader conversion chain no longer interferes with itself @yitenchen123.
• Added two sets of LWJGL runtime libraries (3.3.3 / 3.4.1), picked automatically by game version @yitenchen123.

• Improved memory usage: larger memory limits are detected automatically, and crashes caused by background memory reclaim are reduced @herbrine8403 @yitenchen123.
• Completed missing Simplified Chinese texts and synced official translations @herbrine8403.
• Improved the build and packaging process: dual runtime libraries, reuse of already-built components, clearer build logs @yiyeshi0-hash @yitenchen123.
• For additional changes, please visit the Commits page.

Notes:

To use Vulkan on Minecraft 26.3, select Zink as the renderer and switch the rendering API to Vulkan.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Air uses the local network to find and communicate with AltServer and LAN servers, and to enable multiplayer connectivity via Terracotta (compatible with HMCL/FCL/ZL2).
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Air uses the microphone to enable support for voice chat mods.
